recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20602; any QI-Core profile constraints or R4 extension work referenced in the Jira discussion belong to separate IG/profile maintenance.
issue_request: FHIR-20602 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked for recorded timing support around MedicationAdministration.notGiven and Procedure.notDone and asked whether Period is a default timing type. The final core resolution added Procedure.recorded as 0..1 dateTime with the requested short/definition and workflow Event.recorded mapping, and clarified that FHIR base does not default a data type for choice elements; profiles can constrain types when needed.
initial_application: The core change was applied by cff3828142, merged as 88c604c66b028201ee797438b5154f3366ee7ec0, in source/procedure/procedure-spreadsheet.xml. That commit added Procedure.recorded with dateTime type, the requested short text, and Event.recorded mapping, and left Procedure.occurrence[x] as an explicit choice-type list rather than introducing a default. The later build refactor 33b409a4b6 moved the Procedure definitions into source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes both procedure and medicationadministration. The current Procedure source has Procedure.recorded 0..1 dateTime, an Event.recorded mapping, and the later FHIR-24938 clarification that recorded applies regardless of Procedure.status. MedicationAdministration has occurrence[x] with explicit dateTime, Period, and Timing types and already has a recorded element. FHIR-24938 is already represented on the combined branch, and bounded Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current authoritative source matches the FHIR-20602 resolution when later FHIR-24938 context is considered, and the no-default-type answer is represented by explicit choice element type lists rather than any default Period selection.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the FHIR-20602 Procedure.recorded definition to apply regardless of Procedure.status; already represented on the combined branch.
Jira comments mention a separate QI-Core profile tracker for measure-specific constraints, outside this FHIR-core seed decision.
